title: Simple Minds, Profound Lessons
description: Explore intelligence at its most fundamental level - bacteria navigating chemical gradients, worms seeking warmth, fish solving spatial puzzles. These 'simple' minds reveal core computational principles that scale to complex cognition.
targetAudience: Those curious about the evolutionary origins of intelligence
keyTakeaways: Bacteria exhibit intelligent behavior without neurons
C. elegans has only 302 neurons but complete behavioral repertoire
Intelligence exists on a spectrum from simple to complex
Understanding simple minds illuminates complex cognition
